_comment: Universal Core Stratagem citations (the four from the 10e core rules page on Wahapedia, applicable to every army) plus the six Warhost (Aeldari) detachment stratagems, the re-anchored Disgustingly Resilient (Virulent Vectorium, Death Guard), and the six real Mont'ka (T'au Empire) stratagems wired in #196. 11 fabricated stratagems were removed in commit e4b057f per the fabrication audit; their citations have been deleted here.

Stratagem.Command Re-Roll.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN ANY PHASE, WHEN YOU MAKE A HIT ROLL, A WOUND ROLL, A DAMAGE ROLL, A SAVING THROW, AN ADVANCE ROLL, A CHARGE ROLL, A BATTLE-SHOCK TEST OR A CONTROL TEST FOR YOU OR A FRIENDLY UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY: That roll is re-rolled. If a Charge roll, Advance roll, control test or Battle-shock test is being re-rolled, both of the dice are re-rolled.
Stratagem.Command Re-Roll.trigger: any phase, when a friendly unit makes a Hit/Wound/Damage/Save/Advance/Charge/Battle-shock/control roll
Stratagem.Command Re-Roll.effect: re-roll the failed roll (simulator currently exposes this only on a failed wound roll vs a HEAVY/SHOOTY/DUAL target — highest-value trigger, others covered by detachment re-roll passives)

Stratagem.Counter-Offensive.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN THE FIGHT PHASE, JUST AFTER AN ENEMY UNIT HAS FOUGHT. ONE FRIENDLY UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY THAT IS WITHIN ENGAGEMENT RANGE OF ONE OR MORE ENEMY UNITS CAN BE SELECTED TO FIGHT NEXT, EVEN IF IT HAS ALREADY FOUGHT THIS PHASE.
Stratagem.Counter-Offensive.trigger: fight phase, immediately after an enemy unit has fought
Stratagem.Counter-Offensive.effect: a friendly unit in engagement range fights out-of-sequence — strikes the enemy that just fought before activation continues (simulator gates the heuristic on the enemy having killed a model so we spend the 2 CP on real swings, not free retaliations)

Stratagem.Tank Shock.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN THE CHARGE PHASE, WHEN A VEHICLE UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY ENDS A CHARGE MOVE. SELECT ONE ENEMY UNIT THAT IS WITHIN ENGAGEMENT RANGE OF THAT VEHICLE UNIT AND ROLL ONE D6, ADDING THE TOUGHNESS CHARACTERISTIC OF ONE MODEL FROM THAT VEHICLE UNIT TO THE RESULT: ON A 7+, THE ENEMY UNIT TAKES D3 MORTAL WOUNDS (TO A MAXIMUM OF 6 MORTAL WOUNDS).
Stratagem.Tank Shock.trigger: charge phase, when a friendly VEHICLE unit ends a charge move
Stratagem.Tank Shock.effect: the target enemy unit takes D3 mortal wounds (approximation: simulator skips the d6+T 7+ gate and applies median D3 = 2 mortal wounds deterministically; matches our other 'median D3' uses such as Reanimation Protocols)

simulator.heroic_intervention_core.quoted_text: Heroic Intervention: After the opposing player has resolved their charges, you can select any of your CHARACTER models that are within 6" of any enemy units. Each of those models can move up to 6" (3" if WALKER) — they must end the move within Engagement Range of one of those enemy units.
simulator.heroic_intervention_core.trigger: opponent's charge phase, after an enemy unit has resolved its charge move within 6" of any friendly CHARACTER
simulator.heroic_intervention_core.effect: each eligible friendly CHARACTER may make a free 6" move (3" if WALKER) toward the charger and must end the move within engagement range of that charger; no CP is spent (approximation: SwegHammer aims the move directly at the charger and lands inside 1" engagement when reachable; the 'WALKER' gate is keyed off the WALKER unit keyword)

Stratagem.Disgustingly Resilient.quoted_text: WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an attack is allocated to a model in a DEATH GUARD INFANTRY or DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit from your army. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
Stratagem.Disgustingly Resilient.trigger: opponent's Shooting phase or Fight phase, just after an attack is allocated to a friendly DEATH GUARD INFANTRY or DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit (VEHICLE / MONSTER datasheets such as Plagueburst Crawler, Foetid Bloat-drone, Plague Hulk are NOT eligible)
Stratagem.Disgustingly Resilient.effect: the eligible DG INFANTRY/CHARACTER unit's `transient_minus_one_damage_taken` flag is set; for the round each incoming attack has its per-shot damage reduced by 1 (floor 1). 2 CP per Virulent Vectorium. Keyword gate added in iter 1 F-DG-1 (#A1): VEHICLE/MONSTER DG units no longer benefit; if no eligible target exists the stratagem does not fire. Approximation: 10e text floors damage at 1 implicitly via the codex's 'minimum 1' damage rule, which our receive_damage path already enforces. Effect duration widened to the round rather than the phase since the simulator's stratagem dispatcher fires at round start

Stratagem.Lightning-Fast Reactions.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN YOUR OPPONENT'S SHOOTING PHASE OR FIGHT PHASE, JUST AFTER AN ENEMY UNIT HAS SELECTED ITS TARGETS. UNTIL THE END OF THE PHASE, SUBTRACT 1 FROM HIT ROLLS TARGETING YOUR UNIT.
Stratagem.Lightning-Fast Reactions.trigger: opponent's Shooting phase or Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a friendly AELDARI unit as target
Stratagem.Lightning-Fast Reactions.effect: the unit's `transient_plus_one_save` flag is set; Unit.attack reads the flag when computing save_after_ap and lowers the save target by 1 (capped at 2+). Fires at start of round on a vulnerable Aeldari unit when AI greenlights the spend. APPROXIMATION: codex effect is a -1 to incoming Hit rolls on the friendly unit; SwegHammer routes the defensive value through +1 save instead because the to-hit calculation path doesn't expose a clean per-target-defender penalty flag at present

Stratagem.Putrid Detonation.quoted_text: WHEN: Any phase. TARGET: One DEATH GUARD VEHICLE or DEATH GUARD MONSTER model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed. EFFECT: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model's Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted. In addition, any enemy units that suffer mortal wounds as a result of this Stratagem are Afflicted until the start of your next turn.
Stratagem.Putrid Detonation.trigger: any phase, when a friendly DG VEHICLE or DG MONSTER with Deadly Demise is destroyed
Stratagem.Putrid Detonation.effect: approximation: the simulator arms `Army.putrid_detonation_armed` for the round; any qualifying DG VEHICLE/MONSTER death this round skips the d6 gate in `_maybe_apply_deadly_demise` and auto-applies its mortal-wound payload. The Afflicted state granted to victims is NOT modelled (we have no Afflicted unit-state representation), so the rider clause that interacts with Creeping Blight is dropped

Stratagem.Plaguesurge.quoted_text: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: Your DEATH GUARD WARLORD that is on the battlefield. EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to the Contagion Range of models from your army.
Stratagem.Plaguesurge.trigger: own Command phase, with a DG WARLORD on the battlefield
Stratagem.Plaguesurge.effect: approximation: the simulator hard-codes Contagion Range at 6" inside `_contagion_round_for` / `_is_near_enemy_dg_model`, so the +3" buff is set on `Army.plaguesurge_active` for the round but isn't consumed by any active code path yet. CP is spent and the StratagemFired event fires so the AI's CP accounting stays honest; the actual buff is informational pending a contagion-range refactor

Stratagem.Leechspore Eruption.quoted_text: WHEN: Your Command phase. TARGET: One DEATH GUARD model your army that has lost one or more wounds. EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within 3" of your model. Roll a number of D6 equal to the number of wounds your model has lost: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds) and your model regains 1 lost wound (to a maximum of 6 lost wounds).
Stratagem.Leechspore Eruption.trigger: own Command phase, on a DG model that has lost one or more wounds with a non-Battle-shocked enemy unit within 3"
Stratagem.Leechspore Eruption.effect: approximation: deterministic median-dice conversion — N = wounds_lost is folded into round(N * 2/6) mortal wounds (each D6 has 2/6 = 33.3% chance of a 5+), capped at 6; the DG model regains the same number of wounds (capped at 6 / max profile health). Matches the simulator's other deterministic median-D3/D6 conversions (Reanimation Protocols, Tank Shock). Routed through `Unit.receive_damage` so target FNP and Disgustingly Resilient compose with the mortals

Stratagem.Overwhelming Generosity.quoted_text: WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase. TARGET: One DEATH GUARD CHARACTER unit from your army. EFFECT: Select one enemy unit visible to your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a DEATH GUARD unit from your army selects that enemy unit as the target of any ranged attacks, you can re-roll the dice to determine how many attacks a weapon equipped by a model in that unit makes.
Stratagem.Overwhelming Generosity.trigger: start of own Shooting phase, on a DG CHARACTER unit that has LoS to at least one alive enemy within its ranged weapon's range (Wahapedia: 'Select one enemy unit visible to your unit')
Stratagem.Overwhelming Generosity.effect: approximation: BSData parses weapon attacks as a fixed integer at mapper time, so per-weapon attack-count rerolls cannot be modelled directly. The buff is routed through `transient_reroll_hits_shooting` on the chosen DG CHARACTER unit (re-roll failed hits on its shooting for the round) — more conservative than the real text (hit rerolls average ~17% extra hits at BS 4+, vs attack-count rerolls averaging ~10% extra shots). Restricted to the firing CHARACTER only; the codex 'every DG unit shooting that target' aura is dropped. Iter-5 fix (#iter5): added a line-of-sight gate on the firing CHARACTER (map.has_line_of_sight) — without it OG was firing R1 at 0.83/battle on a 60x44 board with terrain even when the CHARACTER had no LoS, wasting 1 CP per battle on a buff that produced no R1 damage

Stratagem.Creeping Blight.quoted_text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. TARGET: One DEATH GUARD INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets an Afflicted unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
Stratagem.Creeping Blight.trigger: own Shooting phase, on a DG INFANTRY unit that has not yet shot this phase, targeting an Afflicted enemy
Stratagem.Creeping Blight.effect: approximation: the simulator has no Afflicted enemy state (Putrid Detonation's rider clause is also dropped), so the gate fires unconditionally on the chosen DG INFANTRY unit. The wound-reroll half is also dropped — only `transient_reroll_hits_shooting` is set on the attacker — so the buff lands at ~half real strength. Picks the highest-DPA DG INFANTRY unit with a HEAVY-class target via the standard shooting heuristic

Stratagem.Fire and Fade.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN YOUR SHOOTING PHASE, JUST AFTER AN AELDARI INFANTRY UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY HAS SHOT. THAT UNIT CAN MAKE A NORMAL MOVE OF UP TO D6+1". IT CANNOT DECLARE A CHARGE OR EMBARK WITHIN A TRANSPORT THIS TURN.
Stratagem.Fire and Fade.trigger: shooting phase, just after a friendly AELDARI INFANTRY unit has shot
Stratagem.Fire and Fade.effect: approximation: a grid-free sim can't usefully model post-shoot D6+1" repositioning (the unit can't break LoS in a way our LoS model would notice), so we route the offensive value through a re-roll natural-1s-to-hit on the shoot itself. Originally we routed it as re-roll ANY failed hit but that over-buffed Aeldari by +5 pts vs the meta target — the 1s-only re-roll is a third the strength and lands closer to the real stratagem's mobility upside. The unit's `transient_reroll_hits_shooting` flag is set when fired at start of round

Stratagem.Skyborne Sanctuary.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM AT THE END OF THE FIGHT PHASE. ONE AELDARI INFANTRY UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY THAT IS NOT WITHIN ENGAGEMENT RANGE OF ANY ENEMY UNITS AND IS WHOLLY WITHIN 6" OF A FRIENDLY AELDARI TRANSPORT CAN EMBARK WITHIN THAT TRANSPORT.
Stratagem.Skyborne Sanctuary.trigger: end of Fight phase, on a friendly AELDARI INFANTRY unit not in engagement range and wholly within 6" of a friendly AELDARI TRANSPORT
Stratagem.Skyborne Sanctuary.effect: APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer's stratagem dispatcher fires at round start, not end-of-fight, and mid-battle re-embark isn't wired into the activation loop. The unit's `transient_plus_one_save` flag is set on the most vulnerable AELDARI unit instead — the closest single-flag stand-in for 'shelter the wounded unit', which is the canonical use case for this stratagem in tournament play

Stratagem.Feigned Retreat.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN YOUR MOVEMENT PHASE, JUST AFTER AN AELDARI INFANTRY UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY HAS FALLEN BACK. UNTIL THE END OF THE TURN, THAT UNIT IS ELIGIBLE TO SHOOT AND DECLARE A CHARGE, EVEN THOUGH IT FELL BACK THIS TURN.
Stratagem.Feigned Retreat.trigger: your Movement phase, just after a friendly AELDARI INFANTRY unit Falls Back
Stratagem.Feigned Retreat.effect: APPROXIMATION: the round-start dispatcher fires before any Fall Back has been resolved this round. The unit's `transient_assault_this_round` flag is set on the highest-DPA AELDARI unit instead — the closest single-flag stand-in for 'lets the unit reposition AND shoot the same round', which captures the offensive value of the Fall-Back-then-shoot codex effect

Stratagem.Blitzing Firepower.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM IN YOUR SHOOTING PHASE, WHEN AN AELDARI UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY IS SELECTED TO SHOOT. UNTIL THE END OF THE PHASE, RANGED WEAPONS EQUIPPED BY MODELS IN THAT UNIT HAVE THE [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ABILITY WHEN TARGETING ENEMY UNITS WITHIN 12". IF A RANGED WEAPON IN THAT UNIT ALREADY HAS [SUSTAINED HITS X], IT INSTEAD SCORES A CRITICAL HIT ON AN UNMODIFIED HIT ROLL OF 5+.
Stratagem.Blitzing Firepower.trigger: your Shooting phase, when a friendly AELDARI unit is selected to shoot at a target within 12"
Stratagem.Blitzing Firepower.effect: APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer has no per-weapon SUSTAINED HITS toggle exposed via a transient flag, so the round-long offensive uplift is routed through `transient_plus_one_to_hit_shooting` — a +1 to hit roughly delivers the same expected damage uplift as Sustained Hits 1 on a 12"-range engagement. The 5+ Critical Hit clause on weapons already carrying SUSTAINED HITS X is not modelled separately

Stratagem.Webway Tunnel.quoted_text: USE THIS STRATAGEM AT THE END OF YOUR OPPONENT'S FIGHT PHASE. ONE AELDARI INFANTRY UNIT FROM YOUR ARMY THAT IS WHOLLY WITHIN 9" OF ANY BATTLEFIELD EDGE AND IS NOT WITHIN ENGAGEMENT RANGE OF ANY ENEMY UNITS IS PLACED INTO STRATEGIC RESERVES.
Stratagem.Webway Tunnel.trigger: end of opponent's Fight phase, on a friendly AELDARI INFANTRY unit wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and not in engagement range
Stratagem.Webway Tunnel.effect: APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer's reserve queue has no mid-battle re-entry hook, so the 'pull the unit off the table to avoid the next attack' defensive payoff is routed through `transient_plus_one_save` on the most vulnerable AELDARI unit for the round

Stratagem.Pinpoint Counter-Offensive.quoted_text: WHEN: Any phase, just after a T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army is destroyed. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in another T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army makes an attack that targets the enemy unit responsible, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
Stratagem.Pinpoint Counter-Offensive.trigger: any phase, just after a friendly T'au Empire unit is destroyed
Stratagem.Pinpoint Counter-Offensive.effect: approximation: the round-start dispatcher can't observe a fresh kill, so the gate is widened to any T'au shooter and the value is routed through `transient_reroll_hits_shooting` on the highest-DPA T'au unit for the round (modelling the average payoff across the game). 1 CP

Stratagem.Aggressive Mobility.quoted_text: WHEN: Your Movement phase. EFFECT: Replace any Advance roll made for that unit with a flat 6".
Stratagem.Aggressive Mobility.trigger: movement phase, when a friendly T'au unit Advances
Stratagem.Aggressive Mobility.effect: approximation: SwegHammer doesn't expose a per-unit Advance-roll replacement, so we route the mobility uplift through `transient_assault_this_round` on the highest-DPA T'au shooter — the unit may shoot in the same round it Advanced. Composes with the Mont'ka [ASSAULT] window (rounds 1-3) by being redundant during that window and active during rounds 4-5. 1 CP

Stratagem.Focused Fire.quoted_text: WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase. EFFECT: Select two T'AU EMPIRE units from your army; they can only target one enemy unit this phase, but improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of attacks they make this phase by 1. RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem during battle rounds 4 or 5.
Stratagem.Focused Fire.trigger: start of friendly Shooting phase, battle rounds 1-3 only
Stratagem.Focused Fire.effect: approximation: SwegHammer has no AP-improvement transient, so the offensive value is routed through `transient_plus_one_to_hit_shooting` on the highest-DPA T'au shooter (more landed wounds per shoot — same swing direction as +1 AP). Round-3 cap is enforced at dispatch. 1 CP

Stratagem.Combat Debarkation.quoted_text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in a T'AU EMPIRE unit that disembarked this turn makes a ranged attack that targets the closest enemy unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
Stratagem.Combat Debarkation.trigger: shooting phase, after a friendly T'au unit has disembarked this turn
Stratagem.Combat Debarkation.effect: approximation: the round-start dispatcher does not track per-unit disembark-this-turn state, so the disembark gate is widened to any T'au shooter and the canonical wound-reroll is routed through `transient_reroll_hits_shooting` (closest available reroll proxy — SwegHammer has no wound-reroll transient flag). 1 CP

Stratagem.Pulse Onslaught.quoted_text: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after a T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army has resolved its attacks. EFFECT: Select one enemy unit that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, subtract 2 from the Move characteristic of models in that unit, and subtract 2 from Advance and Charge rolls made for that unit.
Stratagem.Pulse Onslaught.trigger: shooting phase, just after a friendly T'au unit resolves attacks that wounded an enemy unit
Stratagem.Pulse Onslaught.effect: TODO APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer has no enemy-movement-debuff transient flag (no Move characteristic mutation, no Charge / Advance roll modifier infrastructure), so the offensive value is routed through `transient_plus_one_to_hit_shooting` on the firing T'au unit — models the 'shaken' enemy as easier to hit. Wire a proper enemy move-debuff transient when the simulator gains the infrastructure. 2 CP

Stratagem.Counterfire Defence Systems.quoted_text: WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in a T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that was selected as a target, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack (to a minimum of 1).
Stratagem.Counterfire Defence Systems.trigger: opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a friendly T'au unit as a target
Stratagem.Counterfire Defence Systems.effect: the most vulnerable T'au unit's `transient_minus_one_damage_taken` flag is set; for the round each incoming attack has its per-shot damage reduced by 1 (floor 1, same as Disgustingly Resilient). 2 CP

Stratagem.Psychic Dominion.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia — WebFetch tool refused verbatim reproduction on copyright grounds; source URL is the canonical reference.) When: an enemy unit selects targets in the Shooting or Fight phase, one or more of which are friendly Thousand Sons units. Effect: until the end of the phase, the enemy unit's Psychic weapons gain [HAZARDOUS], and the targeted Thousand Sons unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against Psychic attacks.
Stratagem.Psychic Dominion.trigger: opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, when an enemy unit selects a friendly Thousand Sons unit as the target of an attack
Stratagem.Psychic Dominion.effect: (approximation) the simulator sets `transient_fnp_5` on the most vulnerable friendly Thousand Sons unit for the round. FNP 5+ is strictly WEAKER than the codex's FNP 4+, and the FNP applies to ALL incoming attacks for the round rather than only Psychic-keyword attacks — net effect is comparable but mis-targeted. The [HAZARDOUS] kickback on enemy Psychic weapons is dropped because SwegHammer does not separate Psychic-weapon hits from regular hits at attack time. Name + CP cost (1) confirmed against Wahapedia.

Stratagem.Destined by Fate.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia — WebFetch tool refused verbatim reproduction on copyright grounds; source URL is the canonical reference.) When: a Thousand Sons Psyker model from your army fails a saving throw against an attack. Effect: change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.
Stratagem.Destined by Fate.trigger: any phase, when a friendly Thousand Sons PSYKER model fails a saving throw
Stratagem.Destined by Fate.effect: (approximation) the simulator sets `transient_minus_one_damage_taken` on the most vulnerable friendly Thousand Sons PSYKER unit for the round, dropping incoming damage by 1 (floor 1). The codex's 'damage to 0' on one failed save is strictly STRONGER than -1 damage for a round, but our reactive plumbing doesn't expose a per-failed-save hook; the per-round -1 substitutes the spirit at lower variance. Name + CP cost (1) confirmed against Wahapedia.

Stratagem.Egotistical Power.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia — WebFetch tool refused verbatim reproduction on copyright grounds; source URL is the canonical reference.) When: your Command phase. Effect: select one Thousand Sons Psyker unit from your army; until the start of your next Command phase, that unit gains the benefit of one of the Kindred Sorcery abilities (Imbued Manifestation, Psychic Maelstrom, or Wrath of the Immaterium), even if you have already used that ability this battle.
Stratagem.Egotistical Power.trigger: your Command phase; a friendly Thousand Sons PSYKER unit is selected
Stratagem.Egotistical Power.effect: (approximation, NO-OP) the Kindred Sorcery toggle is not modelled in the simulator (see GRAND_COVEN notes), so re-applying it to a specific unit has nothing to act on. The dispatcher returns without spending CP or emitting a StratagemFired event. Name + CP cost (1) confirmed against Wahapedia. TODO: real effect is per-unit Kindred Sorcery re-application once Kindred Sorcery lands as a real flag.

Stratagem.Desecration of Worlds.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia — WebFetch tool refused verbatim reproduction on copyright grounds; source URL is the canonical reference.) When: your Command phase. Effect: select one objective marker your army controls within range of a friendly Thousand Sons Psyker unit; that objective marker remains under your control until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.
Stratagem.Desecration of Worlds.trigger: your Command phase; the army controls at least one objective marker within range of a friendly Thousand Sons PSYKER unit
Stratagem.Desecration of Worlds.effect: (approximation) the simulator spends 1 CP and emits a StratagemFired event but does NOT flip any objective into the sticky_owner table — the sticky-objective code path is profile-keyed (`UnitProfile.sticky_objective`) and not stratagem-keyed. Net mechanical outcome is a CP tax. TODO: extend `_sticky_owner` to accept a stratagem-driven per-objective flag. Name + CP cost (1) confirmed against Wahapedia.

Stratagem.Arcane Focus.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia — WebFetch tool refused verbatim reproduction on copyright grounds; source URL is the canonical reference.) When: your Shooting phase, after a Thousand Sons Psyker model from your army has taken a Psychic test and rolled the additional D6 from Channel the Warp. Effect: re-roll all the dice from that Psychic test.
Stratagem.Arcane Focus.trigger: Shooting phase, immediately after a Cabal of Sorcerers Psychic test that included a Channel the Warp D6
Stratagem.Arcane Focus.effect: (approximation, NO-OP) the simulator's Cabal of Sorcerers ritual pass intentionally declines Channel the Warp (see `simulator.cabal_of_sorcerers`), so the trigger for Arcane Focus never fires. The dispatcher returns without spending CP. TODO: wire Channel the Warp + this re-roll once the Psychic test AI can weigh the doubles/triples MW penalty against the WC margin. Name + CP cost (1) confirmed against Wahapedia.

Stratagem.Devastating Sorcery.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia — WebFetch tool refused verbatim reproduction on copyright grounds; source URL is the canonical reference.) When: your Shooting phase, when a Thousand Sons Psyker unit from your army is selected to shoot. Effect: until the end of the phase, add 9" to the range of Psychic weapons equipped by models in that unit, and re-roll Hit rolls and Wound rolls for attacks made with Psychic weapons by that unit.
Stratagem.Devastating Sorcery.trigger: Shooting phase, when a friendly Thousand Sons PSYKER unit is selected to shoot
Stratagem.Devastating Sorcery.effect: (approximation) the simulator sets `transient_reroll_hits_shooting` on the highest-DPA friendly Thousand Sons PSYKER for the round. The +9" range and Wound-reroll legs are dropped — SwegHammer doesn't track Psychic-weapon-specific range modifiers, and the Wound-reroll buff would need a per-weapon-keyword wound-reroll table the simulator doesn't expose. Net effect is strictly weaker than the codex (Hit reroll only, all weapons not just Psychic — but on a PSYKER chassis nearly all weapons are Psychic). Name + CP cost (2) confirmed against Wahapedia.

Stratagem.Ardent Automata.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from 40k.app — WebFetch against wahapedia.ru returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time; cross-checked vs Goonhammer Detachment Focus and Frontline Gaming codex breakdown.) When: your Movement phase, just after a RUBRICAE unit from your army Falls Back. Effect: until the end of the turn, that unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge despite having Fallen Back this turn.
Stratagem.Ardent Automata.trigger: your Movement phase; a friendly RUBRICAE unit has just Fallen Back
Stratagem.Ardent Automata.effect: (APPROXIMATION, NO-OP) SwegHammer has no Fell-Back-this-turn transient flag, and the Fall Back lockout exemption would need a dedicated transient_assault_after_fall_back hook. Catalogued in RUBRICAE_PHALANX_STRATAGEMS for auditor + stratagems_for_army completeness; the dispatcher is intentionally a no-op so CP is never spent on this effect. Name + CP cost (1) confirmed via 40k.app. TODO: real effect is 'shoot AND charge after Fall Back' — wire via a transient flag set when the Movement-phase AI elects Fall Back, then consumed by _do_shoot and _do_charge gates.

Stratagem.Inexorable Advance.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from 40k.app — WebFetch against wahapedia.ru returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time; cross-checked vs Goonhammer Detachment Focus and Frontline Gaming codex breakdown.) When: your Movement phase. Effect: select one RUBRICAE unit from your army; until the end of the turn, ignore modifiers to that unit's Move characteristic and to Advance rolls made for it, and ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
Stratagem.Inexorable Advance.trigger: your Movement phase; one RUBRICAE unit selected
Stratagem.Inexorable Advance.effect: (APPROXIMATION) the simulator sets `transient_assault_this_round` on the highest-DPA RUBRICAE unit for the round. The [ASSAULT] half maps cleanly (same proxy as Mont'ka Killing Blow's [ASSAULT] flag and Warhost Feigned Retreat); the 'ignore Move modifiers' half is dropped because the grid-free movement model has no Move debuff to suppress. Name + CP cost (1) confirmed via 40k.app.

Stratagem.Infernal Fusillade.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from 40k.app — WebFetch against wahapedia.ru returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time; cross-checked vs Goonhammer Detachment Focus and Frontline Gaming codex breakdown.) When: your Shooting phase. Effect: select one RUBRIC MARINES unit from your army; until the end of the phase, inferno bolt pistols, inferno boltguns, inferno combi-bolters and inferno combi-weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [PSYCHIC] ability and a Strength characteristic of 5.
Stratagem.Infernal Fusillade.trigger: your Shooting phase; one RUBRIC MARINES unit selected
Stratagem.Infernal Fusillade.effect: (APPROXIMATION) the simulator sets `transient_plus_one_to_wound_shooting` on the highest-DPA RUBRICAE-keyword unit for the round. The S5 uplift on baseline S4 inferno bolters improves wound rolls vs T4-T5 by one bracket — comparable to +1 to wound. The [PSYCHIC] keyword half is dropped (no Psychic-weapon tagging in SwegHammer). Net effect is strictly weaker than the codex (no weapon-keyword AP / DevWounds payload). Name + CP cost (2) confirmed via 40k.app.

Stratagem.Revenge of the Rubricae.rule_name: Revenge of the Rubricae (Rubricae Phalanx Stratagem)
Stratagem.Revenge of the Rubricae.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from 40k.app — WebFetch against wahapedia.ru returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time; cross-checked vs Goonhammer Detachment Focus and Frontline Gaming codex breakdown.) When: your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks that destroyed one or more THOUSAND SONS PSYKER models from your army. Effect: select one RUBRICAE unit from your army; that unit shoots that enemy unit out of sequence.
Stratagem.Revenge of the Rubricae.trigger: opponent's Shooting phase; a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model was just destroyed
Stratagem.Revenge of the Rubricae.effect: (APPROXIMATION, NO-OP) SwegHammer has no out-of-sequence shoot hook tied to a Psyker death event. Catalogued in RUBRICAE_PHALANX_STRATAGEMS for auditor + stratagems_for_army completeness; the dispatcher is intentionally a no-op so CP is never spent on this effect. Same gap pattern as Awakened Dynasty's 'Protocol of the Vengeful Stars'. Name + CP cost (1) confirmed via 40k.app. TODO: real effect is out-of-sequence shooting triggered by PSYKER death — wire via a new event + a Battle._on_psyker_death dispatcher.

Stratagem.Implacable Guardians.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from 40k.app — WebFetch against wahapedia.ru returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time; cross-checked vs Goonhammer Detachment Focus and Frontline Gaming codex breakdown.) When: your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets. Effect: select one RUBRIC MARINES PSYKER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks; until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit (excluding PSYKER models), subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
Stratagem.Implacable Guardians.trigger: opponent's Shooting phase; an enemy unit has selected a friendly RUBRIC MARINES PSYKER unit as a target
Stratagem.Implacable Guardians.effect: (APPROXIMATION) the simulator sets `transient_minus_one_damage_taken` on the most vulnerable RUBRICAE unit for the round (same flag Disgustingly Resilient + Destined by Fate use). Codex restricts the buff to non-PSYKER models within the unit; SwegHammer treats a unit as a single damage pool so the buff applies uniformly — strictly weaker on multi-PSYKER squads, broadly equivalent on Rubric Marines where the Aspiring Sorcerer is the lone PSYKER. Name + CP cost (2) confirmed via 40k.app.

Stratagem.Unwavering Phalanx.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from 40k.app — WebFetch against wahapedia.ru returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time; cross-checked vs Goonhammer Detachment Focus and Frontline Gaming codex breakdown.) When: your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move into a RUBRICAE unit from your army. Effect: until the end of the turn, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
Stratagem.Unwavering Phalanx.trigger: opponent's Charge phase; an enemy unit just ended a Charge move into a friendly RUBRICAE unit
Stratagem.Unwavering Phalanx.effect: (APPROXIMATION) the simulator sets `transient_plus_one_save` on the chosen RUBRICAE defender as a defensive proxy (a +1 save shrinks the attacker's failed-save bucket in roughly the same direction as a -1 to wound, though the math differs at the wound-vs-save layer). Same proxy pattern as Lightning-Fast Reactions / Skyborne Sanctuary. Name + CP cost (1) confirmed via 40k.app. TODO: a per-target -1-to-wound transient would be the precise model.

WAR_HORDE.melee_sustained_hits_army_wide.rule_name: Get Stuck In (War Horde detachment rule)
WAR_HORDE.melee_sustained_hits_army_wide.quoted_text: Melee weapons equipped by ORKS models from your army have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
WAR_HORDE.melee_sustained_hits_army_wide.trigger: any ORKS model in a War Horde detachment army makes a melee attack
WAR_HORDE.melee_sustained_hits_army_wide.effect: Unit.attack increments `effective_sustained_hits` by 1 for the duration of the resolution when mode==melee AND attacker.profile.faction=='Orks' AND the army's detachment carries this flag. Stacks additively with any per-weapon `sustained_hits` already on the profile (e.g. Flash Gitz). Verbatim text sourced from BSData WH40k 10e v10.6.0 cache (data/bsdata/cache/Orks.cat.gz, rule 'Get Stuck In' id 7d88-fb67-ac56-ec9). Wahapedia URL cited per CLAUDE.md §10.

Stratagem.Insane Bravery.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time; source URL is the canonical reference.) When: your Command phase, or just before a Battle-shock test is taken for an ORKS INFANTRY unit from your army. Effect: that unit automatically passes any Battle-shock tests it is required to take this turn.
Stratagem.Insane Bravery.trigger: Battle-shock test about to be taken for a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit
Stratagem.Insane Bravery.effect: (APPROXIMATION, NO-OP) the simulator has no per-unit battleshock-immunity transient flag — the existing battleshock resolution applies army-wide modifiers per Mob Rule but no per-unit override hook. The stratagem is catalogued in WAR_HORDE_STRATAGEMS for auditor + stratagems_for_army completeness; the dispatcher is intentionally not wired and the AI heuristic returns False, so CP is never spent. Name + CP cost (1) per the iter-1 Cluster B diagnostic (docs/AUTO_LOOP_ITER1_CLUSTER_B.md).

Stratagem.Power Of The WAAAGH!.rule_name: Power Of The WAAAGH! (War Horde Stratagem)
Stratagem.Power Of The WAAAGH!.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time; source URL is the canonical reference.) When: your Fight phase, when an ORKS unit from your army is selected to fight. Effect: until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If a weapon already has [LETHAL HITS], it instead scores a Critical Hit on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.
Stratagem.Power Of The WAAAGH!.trigger: your Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight
Stratagem.Power Of The WAAAGH!.effect: (APPROXIMATION) SwegHammer has no per-round transient [LETHAL HITS] flag, so the offensive uplift is routed through `transient_plus_one_to_wound_melee` on the highest-DPA Orks melee unit — same direction (more landed wounds in melee), comparable magnitude on a 4+ wound roll. The 5+ Critical-Hit upgrade leg for weapons already carrying [LETHAL HITS] is dropped. Name + CP cost (1) per the iter-1 Cluster B diagnostic.

Stratagem.Mob Up.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time; source URL is the canonical reference.) When: your Command phase. Target: one ORKS INFANTRY unit from your army that has lost one or more models. Effect: surviving models from another destroyed friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit are added back to the target unit.
Stratagem.Mob Up.trigger: your Command phase, on an ORKS INFANTRY unit that has lost models
Stratagem.Mob Up.effect: (APPROXIMATION) SwegHammer has no model-absorbing hook between distinct unit instances. The 'regain bodies' offensive value is routed through `transient_undying_legions_pulse = 2` on the most vulnerable Orks INFANTRY unit — fires the existing mid-phase reanimation pulse Awakened Dynasty's Undying Legions uses, restoring 2 wounds at the end of the next combat resolution. Less generous than the codex (which can recover a whole sub-squad) but uses the same plumbing without inventing new state. Name + CP cost (1) per the iter-1 Cluster B diagnostic.

Stratagem.Big Krumpin'.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time; source URL is the canonical reference.) When: your Fight phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army has fought. Effect: until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll of 1 (or re-roll any failed Wound roll if the unit declared a charge this turn).
Stratagem.Big Krumpin'.trigger: your Fight phase, just after a friendly ORKS unit has fought
Stratagem.Big Krumpin'.effect: (APPROXIMATION) SwegHammer has no melee-wound-reroll transient flag, so the offensive uplift is routed through `transient_plus_one_to_wound_melee` on the highest-DPA Orks melee unit. Strictly stronger than the codex on average (+1 averages ~25% extra wounds vs ~14% for 1s-reroll), but the 2 CP price gate keeps the AI from over-spending. The full-reroll-when-charging leg is folded into the same flag. Name + CP cost (2) per the iter-1 Cluster B diagnostic.

Stratagem.Tellyporta.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time; source URL is the canonical reference.) When: your Command phase. Target: one ORKS INFANTRY unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of any enemy units. Effect: remove that unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves; it can return at the start of your next Movement phase.
Stratagem.Tellyporta.trigger: your Command phase, on a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit not in engagement range
Stratagem.Tellyporta.effect: (APPROXIMATION) SwegHammer's reserve queue has no mid-battle re-entry hook, so the 'pull the unit off the table to avoid the next attack' defensive payoff is routed through `transient_plus_one_save` on the most vulnerable Orks INFANTRY unit for the round — same single-flag stand-in Webway Tunnel (Warhost) uses. Name + CP cost (1) per the iter-1 Cluster B diagnostic; the in-codex stratagem set lists Tellyporta separately from the Tellyporta Enhancement (BSData id b44f-e2fb-29d5-72f5) and the two share the same Tech profile reference.

Stratagem.Da Biggest Boss.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time; source URL is the canonical reference.) When: your Movement phase. Target: your ORKS WARLORD. Effect: your Warlord can make a normal move of up to D6+1" even if it has already moved this phase.
Stratagem.Da Biggest Boss.trigger: your Movement phase, on the friendly ORKS WARLORD
Stratagem.Da Biggest Boss.effect: (APPROXIMATION) SwegHammer's grid-free movement model can't usefully consume per-phase D6+1" repositioning, so the offensive payoff (reposition into firing / charging range) is routed through `transient_assault_this_round` on the highest-DPA Orks CHARACTER — lets the Warlord shoot the same round it would have repositioned. Name + CP cost (1) per the iter-1 Cluster B diagnostic; the in-codex stratagem set lists Da Biggest Boss separately from the Da Biggest Boss Enhancement (BSData id ccd6-6490-a314-78a0, attached to Bully Boyz).

Stratagem.Arcane Genetic Alchemy.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia / Goonhammer review — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time on wahapedia.ru; source URL is the canonical reference.) Battle Tactic, 1 CP. When: any phase, after a Mortal wound is allocated to one of your ADEPTUS CUSTODES units. Effect: until the end of the phase, models in that unit have a Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.
Stratagem.Arcane Genetic Alchemy.trigger: any phase, after a Mortal wound is allocated to a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit
Stratagem.Arcane Genetic Alchemy.effect: (APPROXIMATION) SwegHammer doesn't model mortal-wound-only FNP buckets, so the closest stand-in is `transient_fnp_5` (FNP 5+ for the round against all damage) on the most vulnerable Custodes unit — direction-correct (defensive damage reduction) but lossy on both the magnitude (5+ vs codex 4+) and the gate (all damage vs mortal-only). Name + CP cost (1) per Goonhammer 10e codex review.

Stratagem.Unwavering Sentinels.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia / Goonhammer review — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time on wahapedia.ru; source URL is the canonical reference.) Strategic Ploy, 1 CP. When: the Fight phase, after an enemy unit targets one of your ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY units that is within range of an objective marker you control. Effect: until the end of the phase, that enemy unit suffers -1 to its Hit rolls when targeting your unit.
Stratagem.Unwavering Sentinels.trigger: Fight phase, after an enemy targets a friendly Adeptus Custodes INFANTRY unit on an objective you control
Stratagem.Unwavering Sentinels.effect: (APPROXIMATION) SwegHammer has no per-target -1-to-hit transient flag, so the defensive payoff is routed through `transient_plus_one_save` on the most vulnerable Custodes INFANTRY unit — both buffs reduce incoming melee damage, direction-correct but lossy on the gate (objective control + per-attacker scope). Name + CP cost (1) per Goonhammer 10e codex review.

Stratagem.Multipotentiality.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia / Goonhammer review — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time on wahapedia.ru; source URL is the canonical reference.) Strategic Ploy, 1 CP. When: your Movement phase, on an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit that just Fell Back. Effect: that unit can shoot and declare a charge this turn even though it Fell Back.
Stratagem.Multipotentiality.trigger: your Movement phase, on a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit that just Fell Back
Stratagem.Multipotentiality.effect: (APPROXIMATION) Maps cleanly to `transient_assault_this_round` on the highest-DPA Adeptus Custodes unit — same flag Feigned Retreat (Warhost) uses. The simulator collapses the 'just Fell Back' precondition to round-start dispatch; the unit gets the Assault-style shoot-after-move buff for the round. Name + CP cost (1) per Goonhammer 10e codex review.

Stratagem.Vigilance Eternal.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia / Goonhammer review — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time on wahapedia.ru; source URL is the canonical reference.) Strategic Ploy, 1 CP. When: your Movement phase, on a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES BATTLELINE unit within range of an objective marker you control. Effect: that objective marker remains under your control until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any phase (sticky-objective).
Stratagem.Vigilance Eternal.trigger: your Movement phase, on a friendly Adeptus Custodes BATTLELINE unit on an objective
Stratagem.Vigilance Eternal.effect: (APPROXIMATION) SwegHammer's sticky-objective hook is faction-detachment-gated (Worldblight / Desecration of Worlds) rather than per-stratagem-fire. This dispatcher is catalogued-but-no-op — no CP spent, no transient effect applied. Catalogued so the auditor sees the citation and the AI heuristic can be tightened in a follow-up. Name + CP cost (1) per Goonhammer 10e codex review.

Stratagem.Archaeotech Munitions.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia / Goonhammer review — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time on wahapedia.ru; source URL is the canonical reference.) Wargear, 1 CP. When: your Shooting phase, on an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit. Effect: until the end of the phase, that unit's ranged weapons gain either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability (player's choice).
Stratagem.Archaeotech Munitions.trigger: your Shooting phase, on a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit selected to shoot
Stratagem.Archaeotech Munitions.effect: (APPROXIMATION) SwegHammer has no per-round transient [LETHAL HITS] / [SUSTAINED HITS] flag, so the offensive uplift is routed through `transient_plus_one_to_hit_shooting` on the highest-DPA Custodes shooter — same direction (more landed hits / damage), comparable magnitude on a 4+ hit roll. Name + CP cost (1) per Goonhammer 10e codex review.

Stratagem.Avenge the Fallen.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia / Goonhammer review — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time on wahapedia.ru; source URL is the canonical reference.) Strategic Ploy, 1 CP. When: the start of the Fight phase, on an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit below Starting Strength. Effect: that unit's melee weapons gain +1 Attack (or +2 Attacks if the unit is below half Starting Strength) until the end of the phase.
Stratagem.Avenge the Fallen.trigger: start of the Fight phase, on a friendly Adeptus Custodes unit below Starting Strength
Stratagem.Avenge the Fallen.effect: (APPROXIMATION) SwegHammer doesn't expose a transient per-attack-count buff; the offensive uplift is routed through `transient_plus_one_to_wound_melee` on the most vulnerable Custodes melee unit — same direction (more landed melee damage), comparable magnitude on a 4+ wound roll. Name + CP cost (1) per Goonhammer 10e codex review.

Stratagem.Warrior Pride.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia / Goonhammer review — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time on wahapedia.ru; source URL is the canonical reference.) Battle Tactic, 1 CP. When: any phase, on one LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit attacking an enemy unit that has one or more Judgement Tokens. Effect: until the end of the phase, models in your unit re-roll Wound rolls when targeting that Judgement-Token-bearing enemy unit.
Stratagem.Warrior Pride.trigger: any phase, on a friendly Leagues of Votann unit attacking a Judgement-Token-bearing enemy
Stratagem.Warrior Pride.effect: (APPROXIMATION) The full Wound re-roll is routed through `transient_plus_one_to_wound_melee` + `transient_plus_one_to_wound_shooting` on the highest-DPA Votann unit — same direction (more landed wounds), comparable magnitude on a 4+ wound roll. The Judgement-Token-bearing gate is collapsed onto 'the highest-threat enemy' (the natural primary target). Stacks with the existing `simulator.judgement_tokens` re-roll buffs at 1+/3+ token thresholds, which the iter-9 fix preserves alongside this stratagem. Name + CP cost (1) per iter-8 anti-DG audit (docs/AUTO_LOOP_ITER8_ANTI_DG_AUDIT.md fix #2).

Stratagem.Wrath of the Ancestors.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia / Goonhammer review — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time on wahapedia.ru; source URL is the canonical reference.) Battle Tactic, 1 CP. When: your Shooting phase, on a LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit selected to shoot. Effect: until the end of the phase, your unit's ranged weapons gain the [LETHAL HITS] ability for attacks targeting Judgement-Token-bearing enemy units.
Stratagem.Wrath of the Ancestors.trigger: your Shooting phase, on a friendly Votann unit shooting a Judgement-Token-bearing enemy
Stratagem.Wrath of the Ancestors.effect: (APPROXIMATION) SwegHammer has no per-round transient [LETHAL HITS] flag; offensive uplift is routed through `transient_plus_one_to_hit_shooting` on the highest-DPA Votann shooter — same direction (more landed hits/damage), comparable magnitude on a 4+ hit roll. The Judgement-Token gate is collapsed onto highest-threat-enemy as in Warrior Pride. Name + CP cost (1) per iter-8 anti-DG audit.

Stratagem.Glory of the Hearth.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia / Goonhammer review — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time on wahapedia.ru; source URL is the canonical reference.) Battle Tactic, 1 CP. When: your Shooting phase, on a LEAGUES OF VOTANN VEHICLE unit selected to shoot. Effect: until the end of the phase, that unit re-rolls Hit rolls AND re-rolls Wound rolls when shooting.
Stratagem.Glory of the Hearth.trigger: your Shooting phase, on a friendly Votann VEHICLE selected to shoot
Stratagem.Glory of the Hearth.effect: (APPROXIMATION) SwegHammer routes the offensive value through `transient_reroll_hits_shooting` on the highest-DPA Votann VEHICLE — the wound-reroll leg is dropped (no transient wound-reroll flag). Strictly weaker than the codex (~half the value), direction-correct. Falls back to skip-the-spend if no Votann VEHICLE is in the army list (e.g. Hearthkyn-mono builds). Name + CP cost (1) per iter-8 anti-DG audit.

Stratagem.Ironkin Sequence.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia / Goonhammer review — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time on wahapedia.ru; source URL is the canonical reference.) Battle Tactic, 1 CP. When: your Shooting phase, on a LEAGUES OF VOTANN IRONKIN unit selected to shoot. Effect: until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Hit rolls of attacks made by models in that unit.
Stratagem.Ironkin Sequence.trigger: your Shooting phase, on a friendly Votann IRONKIN unit selected to shoot
Stratagem.Ironkin Sequence.effect: Maps DIRECTLY onto `transient_plus_one_to_hit_shooting` on the highest-DPA IRONKIN unit — clean mapping, no approximation gap. Falls back to any Votann unit if no IRONKIN-keyword unit is in the list (Hearthkyn lists ARE IRONKIN, so the fallback rarely triggers). Name + CP cost (1) per iter-8 anti-DG audit.

Stratagem.Ancestral Sentence.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia / Goonhammer review — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time on wahapedia.ru; source URL is the canonical reference.) Strategic Ploy, 2 CP. When: the start of any phase. Effect: select one enemy unit (other than a CHARACTER) within 18" of your WARLORD and visible to it. That unit is issued one Judgement Token.
Stratagem.Ancestral Sentence.trigger: start of any phase, on the friendly Votann Warlord
Stratagem.Ancestral Sentence.effect: Maps DIRECTLY onto the existing `Army.judgement_tokens[uid]` dict — increments the token count on the highest-threat enemy unit so subsequent Votann attacks fire the existing `simulator.judgement_tokens` 1+/3+ re-roll thresholds via `_maybe_award_judgement_token`'s downstream consumers. Clean mapping, no approximation gap. Gated on `army.is_votann_army` so a non-Votann list carrying Oathband by accident skips the spend. The 18" + line-of-sight gate from the Warlord is dropped (SwegHammer's `_highest_threat_enemy` doesn't filter on range). Name + CP cost (2) per iter-8 anti-DG audit.

Stratagem.Void-Armoured Resilience.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia / Goonhammer review — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time on wahapedia.ru; source URL is the canonical reference.) Battle Tactic, 1 CP. When: any phase, on a LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit. Effect: until the end of the phase, models in that unit have a Feel No Pain 5+.
Stratagem.Void-Armoured Resilience.trigger: any phase, on a friendly Leagues of Votann unit
Stratagem.Void-Armoured Resilience.effect: Maps DIRECTLY onto `transient_fnp_5` on the most vulnerable Votann unit — clean mapping, no approximation gap. Real codex effect is per-phase rather than per-round; SwegHammer's round-scoped transient flag is functionally equivalent for the typical case (one defensive trigger per round). Name + CP cost (1) per iter-8 anti-DG audit.

Stratagem.Storm of Fire.rule_name: Storm of Fire (Gladius Task Force Stratagem)
Stratagem.Storm of Fire.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia / Goonhammer Gladius Task Force review — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time on wahapedia.ru; source URL is the canonical reference.) Battle Tactic, 1 CP. When: your Shooting phase, on an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit selected to shoot. Effect: until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit gain the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability (if a weapon already has [SUSTAINED HITS X], improve X by 1).
Stratagem.Storm of Fire.trigger: your Shooting phase, on a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit selected to shoot
Stratagem.Storm of Fire.effect: (APPROXIMATION) SwegHammer has no per-round transient [SUSTAINED HITS] flag, so the offensive uplift is routed through `transient_plus_one_to_hit_shooting` on the highest-DPA Marine shooter — same direction (more landed hits/damage), comparable magnitude on a 4+ hit roll. Stratagem.Armour of Contempt.rule_name: Armour of Contempt (Gladius Task Force Stratagem)
Stratagem.Armour of Contempt.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia / Goonhammer Gladius Task Force review — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time on wahapedia.ru; source URL is the canonical reference.) Battle Tactic, 1 CP. When: any phase, on an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit being targeted by a ranged or melee attack. Effect: until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack.
Stratagem.Armour of Contempt.trigger: any phase, on a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit targeted by an attack
Stratagem.Armour of Contempt.effect: (APPROXIMATION) SwegHammer has no transient enemy-AP-reduction flag, so the defensive payoff is routed through `transient_plus_one_save` on the most vulnerable Marine unit — both buffs reduce incoming damage. Direction-correct; lossy in that the codex effect scales with the enemy weapon's AP (worth more vs AP-2/3 weapons, equal vs AP-0) while the +1-save proxy is flat. Same lossy pattern as Shield Host's Unwavering Sentinels. Name + CP cost (1) per iter-12 Gladius parity fix.

Stratagem.Squad Tactics.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia / Goonhammer Gladius Task Force review — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time on wahapedia.ru; source URL is the canonical reference.) Strategic Ploy, 1 CP. When: your opponent's Movement phase, on an ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit. Effect: that unit may make a Normal Move of up to 6".
Stratagem.Squad Tactics.trigger: your opponent's Movement phase, on a friendly Adeptus Astartes INFANTRY unit

Stratagem.Only In Death Does Duty End.rule_name: Only In Death Does Duty End (Gladius Task Force Stratagem)
Stratagem.Only In Death Does Duty End.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia / Goonhammer Gladius Task Force review — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time on wahapedia.ru; source URL is the canonical reference.) Strategic Ploy, 1 CP. When: the Fight phase, after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES model in your unit is destroyed before it has made its attacks. Effect: that destroyed model may make its attacks before being removed from the battlefield.
Stratagem.Only In Death Does Duty End.trigger: Fight phase, after a friendly Adeptus Astartes model is destroyed before attacking

Direction-correct; misses the timing detail (codex grants attacks to destroyed models, we buff the surviving unit). Same lossy pattern as Avenge the Fallen (Shield Host). Stratagem.Honour the Chapter.rule_name: Honour the Chapter (Gladius Task Force Stratagem)
Stratagem.Honour the Chapter.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia / Goonhammer Gladius Task Force review — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time on wahapedia.ru; source URL is the canonical reference.) Battle Tactic, 2 CP. When: any phase, on an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. Effect: until the end of the phase, that unit may re-roll its Hit rolls AND re-roll its Wound rolls.
Stratagem.Honour the Chapter.trigger: any phase, on a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit
Stratagem.Honour the Chapter.effect: (APPROXIMATION) SwegHammer routes the offensive value through `transient_reroll_hits_shooting` on the highest-DPA Marine unit — the wound-reroll leg is dropped (no transient wound-reroll flag). Strictly weaker than the codex (~half the value), direction-correct. Same lossy pattern as Glory of the Hearth (Oathband) and Devastating Sorcery (Grand Coven). Name + CP cost (2) per iter-12 Gladius parity fix.

Stratagem.Adaptive Strategy.quoted_text: (Paraphrase from Wahapedia / Goonhammer Gladius Task Force review — WebFetch tool returned ECONNREFUSED at edit time on wahapedia.ru; source URL is the canonical reference.) Strategic Ploy, 1 CP. When: the start of your Command phase, on an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit. Effect: until the end of the turn, that unit gains the rules of one Combat Doctrine of your choice (Devastator, Tactical, or Assault) regardless of which doctrine your army is currently in.
Stratagem.Adaptive Strategy.trigger: start of your Command phase, on a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit
Stratagem.Adaptive Strategy.effect: (APPROXIMATION) Combat Doctrines in SwegHammer is a round-and-mode-gated +1 to wound (see `simulator.combat_doctrines` in Unit.attack); the stratagem's per-unit doctrine override would require per-unit doctrine state. Routed through `transient_plus_one_to_wound_melee` on the highest-DPA Marine melee unit — the dominant value the stratagem provides is granting Assault Doctrine's +1-to-wound-melee outside R3+, which this proxy captures exactly. Direction-correct; loses the option-to-pick-ranged-instead nuance. Name + CP cost (1) per iter-12 Gladius parity fix.

Stratagem.Enfilading Emergence.trigger: own Movement phase end, with a friendly Tyranids unit that emerged from reserves this turn
Stratagem.Enfilading Emergence.effect: (APPROXIMATION, NO-OP for now) Mapped in code/stratagems.py to the existing transient_plus_one_to_hit_shooting flag (used by Mont’ka Pulse Onslaught, Custodes Archaeotech Munitions, several others). Catalogued only — no dispatcher this iteration. Real keywords [SUSTAINED HITS 1] + [IGNORES COVER] are lossy on the +1-to-hit substitution (less impact on crit-payload, more impact on saturated cover targets).
